text:
monitoring-bot: Alert: spike in 500s on /v1/notify and multiple failed pages reported by incident pipeline (last 3m). Rolling count: 48 errors, 22 failed pages :warning:
inc-bot: attempted to page oncall group `infra-sre`, 11/11 deliver attempts returned 502 from pagerflow webhook. sample: `POST /webhook/pagerflow -> 502 {"error":"upstream timeout"}`
Erin (oncall): I'm oncall — starting triage. Are pages queuing?
Max (SRE): checking the queue — looks like the outgoing pager queue is accumulating. `inc-bridge` logs show HMAC verification failures for recent requests.
Jess (eng-deploy): we rotated the pagerflow signing key in prod earlier today as part of cert housekeeping. Did we update the bridge config?
Nora (ops): I didn't touch the bridge. Who owns the signing secret mapping?
Erin (oncall): @Jess any chance the new key wasn't deployed to the notify bridge?
Jess (eng-deploy): hmm, pipeline ran but the secret template failed on one host (failed to reload systemd unit). Investigating.
inc-bot: delivery summary: queued=23, sent=0, failed=23 (hmac:invalid_signature).
Max (SRE): can confirm logs: `hmac: signature mismatch` on outgoing -> pagerflow. That explains 502s (pagerflow rejects).
Erin (oncall): workaround — can someone re-add the old key to the bridge config so it can accept both keys temporarily? We need pages out now.
Jess (eng-deploy): I can push a fast rollback to the secret bundle. Executing sudo salt -C 'role:notify-bridge' state.apply notify.bridge-keys-rollback now.
Nora (ops): FYI, PagerDuty-bot is still showing new incidents not acknowledged due to webhook failures. Customers may not be getting pages.
PagerDuty-bot: webhook delivery error: 502 Bad Gateway -> response body: `{"errors":[{"code":"upstream_timeout"}]}`
Erin (oncall): Start manual paging for critical customers while we fix webhook — use the emergency SMS relay (ops playbook). I'm marking impacted customers in the incident.
Max (SRE): after rollback, restarting notify-bridge on host notify-bridge-03: `systemctl restart notify-bridge`
Jess (eng-deploy): rollback applied, bridge restarted. Watching delivery metrics...
inc-bot: re-attempting queued pages (11) now. status: 10/11 delivered, 1/11 failed (retry scheduled). :white_check_mark:
Erin (oncall): nice. Customer impact: several internal on-call notifications missed for 8-12 minutes. External customer pages: 4 customers had delayed pages (all recovered). No confirmed escalations to CS yet.
Nora (ops): logged a manual page for cust-xyz during outage — they acknowledged.
Max (SRE): root cause appears to be partial secret rollout combined with no dual-key acceptance window. Deploy change caused HMAC failures -> pagerflow rejected requests -> inc-bot queued messages.
Erin (oncall): immediate mitigation steps captured in thread. Please add to incident checklist: 1) support dual-key acceptance for 15m during rotations, 2) rollout verification alert if outgoing pages >5 fail in 5m, 3) healthcheck for notify-bridge signing key freshness.
Jess (eng-deploy): I'll open a PR for dual-key fallback and add post-deploy hook to validate webhook handshake.
Max (SRE): filing a P1 ticket for postmortem and remediation with timeline. Assigning to `eng-oncall` and `platform-security`.
Erin (oncall): thanks all. I'll update incident channel and send a short customer note template for delayed pages.
Nora (ops): postmortem note: mitigation took ~9 minutes from detection to successful rollback.
inc-bot: incident closed? manual follow-up required: yes. tagging: `followup-required`, `pager-integration`, `deploy-rollback`
Erin (oncall): adding action items to the incident doc and scheduling a 30m retro 1:30pm UTC. :calendar:
Max (SRE): suggest adding an automated canary after key rotation that sends a test page and verifies 200 response within 30s.
Jess (eng-deploy): agreed. I'll include canary in rollout pipeline.
Erin (oncall): great — closing this thread for live ops. Will post the postmortem link once the ticket is created. :lock:
